deprecated-context.purpose: validate the contextual deprecated word and attach the annotation at the handwritten seam

pattern-decl.purpose: validate view/make clauses and construct the declaration

pat-clause-word.purpose: accept only contextual view or make

migration-route.purpose: validate auto/version route names and ordered fields

migration-dir.purpose: normalize a bare auto expression into the derived migration direction

flip-class.purpose: recognize and refuse the retired real-brace class body

flip-instance.purpose: recognize and refuse the retired real-brace instance body

kind-validation.purpose: map and validate Type, Row, or Nat

typearg-natural.purpose: reject suffixes and overflow before constructing a natural

dimension-decline.purpose: consume and deliberately refuse dimension addition

flip-effect.purpose: recognize and refuse the retired real-brace effect body

effect-grade.purpose: validate contextual many, once, or never

lift-noalloc.purpose: extract the root noalloc usage certificate from a return type

decl-mods.purpose: validate the bounded contextual test/assume/total run

statement-sugar.purpose: construct open-if, with, let/sequence, and statement-try forms with pinned spans and synth bits

return-order.purpose: recognize and refuse retired prefix return effects

return-binding.purpose: bound the method return-type view and attach a following effect at the correct layer

param-normalize.purpose: name positional pattern parameters and normalize irrefutable parameter wrapping

type-effect-attach.purpose: attach a function effect and refuse effects on non-functions or misbound usage rows

usage-validate.purpose: validate empty, open, unknown, duplicate, and conflicting usage rows

expr-top-sugar.purpose: validate reflection and assignment targets and construct top-level sugar

handler-grade.purpose: validate contextual handler grades and the resumed-continuation migration

resume-migration.purpose: validate contextual resume and refuse the retired trailing continuation

dot-op-retired.purpose: consume retired dot operators and issue the pointed replacement

try-mark.purpose: mark postfix try for statement-level recognition

dot-call.purpose: construct UFCS calls with their receiver and authored extent

interpolation.purpose: lower interpolation parts with pinned literal/hole spans

productions.name: Comma

depth.detail: List/range/multi-index elements are siblings; each child spends only at its own entry.

productions.name: Program

productions.name: Items

productions.name: Route

productions.name: Rung

productions.name: FrozenBadge

productions.name: ConvKw

productions.name: DropLoss

depth.detail: Identifier list siblings do not spend.

productions.name: InstanceD

productions.name: InstFns

depth.detail: Methods are siblings and reuse the enclosing budget.

productions.name: CanonicalD

depth.detail: Constructors and their Type children receive the current budget and spend at type entry.

productions.name: Newtype

depth.detail: Constructor Type children spend at their own entries.

productions.name: CtorsRhs

productions.name: Derives

productions.name: TyParams

productions.name: KindedTyParams
productions.decision: ( selects a comma list of KindedTyParam and commits through ).

depth.detail: Kinded parameter siblings do not enter recursive type syntax.

productions.name: KindedTyParam
productions.decision: After ident, ':' selects a kind annotation and follow selects the Type default; kind payload validation is escaped.

depth.detail: The kind is a uid payload, not recursive Type syntax.

productions.name: Ctors

depth.detail: Constructor siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: Ctor

depth.detail: Field/argument types spend at parse_type or parse_type_arg; siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: CtorArgs
productions.decision: ( selects Comma<TypeArg> and commits through ).

depth.detail: Each TypeArg calls the spending parse_type_arg entry; sibling arguments reuse the caller's depth.

productions.name: TypeArg
productions.decision: '{' selects a row; int followed by '+' or ident followed by '+' selects the declined dimension run; plain int selects natural; all other Type FIRST selects Type.

depth.detail: parse_type_arg is a frozen direct descend entry; ordinary TypeArg falls into parse_type_arg_body without a second type-entry spend.

productions.name: DimTerm
productions.decision: int and ident token kinds are disjoint dimension operands.

depth.detail: The operand is consumed only for the deliberate dimension diagnostic.

productions.name: DimTail
productions.decision: After one DimTerm, '+' selects another iteration and the registered follow ends the consumed diagnostic run.

depth.detail: The right-recursive Rust rule is lowered by parse_dim_tail as an iterative, nonspending chain.

productions.name: RecordField
productions.decision: ident : is a fixed prefix followed by Type.

depth.detail: The field Type spends at parse_type.

productions.name: AliasOrSynonym
productions.decision: alias uid plus optional '(' params is a shared prefix; AliasRhs's '{' versus Type selector determines the result variant.

depth.detail: A type-synonym RHS spends at parse_type; effect-label arguments spend at parse_type_arg.

productions.name: AliasRhs
productions.decision: '{' selects an effect-label row; otherwise Type FIRST selects the synonym RHS.

depth.detail: Selected effect labels/type enter their spending children.

productions.name: ErrorD
productions.decision: error uid is a fixed prefix; '(' selects optional CtorArgs and follow selects none.

depth.detail: Type arguments spend through parse_type_arg.

productions.name: EffDecl
productions.decision: effect uid plus optional params is shared; v{ selects the live layout body and { selects the fully recognized retired fault.

depth.detail: Operation parameter/return types spend at their entries; operation siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: EffOpSep
productions.decision: comma and v; are disjoint separator tokens.

depth.detail: One separator token is consumed.

productions.name: EffOpList
productions.decision: EffOp FIRST versus close selects entry; EffOpSep versus close selects continuation.

depth.detail: Operation siblings reuse depth; nested types spend independently.

productions.name: EffOp
productions.decision: ident followed by '(' selects unmarked operation; ident followed by ident selects grade-plus-name. The grade payload is validated after selection.

depth.detail: Parameter and return types spend at their own entries.

productions.name: EffOpParam
productions.decision: Consume an ident prefix once; ':' selects a discarded binder, otherwise continue it as Type. Other Type FIRST tokens select Type directly.

depth.detail: The selected Type spends at parse_type.

productions.name: Fn
productions.decision: The bounded DeclMods/replayable/FipKw prefix is factored before reserved fn; subsequent punctuation and clause heads select optional pieces without rollback.

depth.detail: Fn itself does not descend; Params patterns/types, return types, contracts, body, and where expressions spend at their entries.

productions.name: DeclMods
productions.decision: At most three consecutive ident payloads before the reserved modifier/fn follow are captured with bounded lookahead; their canonical order is validated as one run.

depth.detail: The contextual run is bounded to three and never spends.

productions.name: ReflectTarget
productions.decision: ident, uid, and qual token kinds are disjoint.

depth.detail: One name token is consumed.

productions.name: Requires
productions.decision: Reserved requires selects exactly one following Expr.

depth.detail: Expr spends at parse_expr.

productions.name: Ensures
productions.decision: Reserved ensures and the two bars form a fixed binder prefix followed by Expr.

depth.detail: Expr spends at parse_expr.

productions.name: Decreases
productions.decision: An ident at the registered clause position selects the run; contextual decreases is validated after its Expr is consumed.

depth.detail: The measure Expr spends at parse_expr.

productions.name: LogicFn
productions.decision: Reserved logic selects the complete Fn child.

depth.detail: All recursive work belongs to Fn children.

productions.name: FipKw
productions.decision: fip, fbip, or the declared fn-follow epsilon are disjoint selectors.

depth.detail: At most one reserved token is consumed.

productions.name: ConstD
productions.decision: let ident is a fixed declaration prefix; ':' selects optional Type and '=' commits to ExprOrBlock.

depth.detail: Optional Type and body Expr/Block spend at their entries.

productions.name: WhereBlock
productions.decision: where v{ selects the list; WhereBind FIRST, v;, and v} select entries and continuation.

depth.detail: Bindings are siblings; each RHS expression/block spends independently.

productions.name: WhereBind
productions.decision: After ident =, v{ selects BlockExpr and every other registered expression head selects Expr.

depth.detail: The selected Expr or BlockExpr child spends in its expression entry.

productions.name: ExprOrBlock
productions.decision: v{ selects BlockExpr; the Expr leading menu excludes v{ and selects Expr.

depth.detail: Expr spends at parse_expr; BlockExpr's Stmts descend through their expression children.

productions.name: BlockExpr
productions.decision: v{ selects the sole block form and commits through Stmts to v}; the wrapper applies its explicit span policy.

depth.detail: The block wrapper does not descend; Stmts expressions spend at parse_expr.

productions.name: Stmts
productions.decision: Reserved if/let/var/with heads select special statements; otherwise parse the shared Expr once and inspect v; versus block close. let ident versus LetPat is selected by token kind after let.

depth.detail: Statement-tail iteration is nonspending; every nested Expr/Block/LetPat child spends at its registered entry.

productions.name: RetAnn

depth.detail: RetType enters the frozen return-binding path and its nested types spend at registered entries.

productions.name: RetType
productions.decision: forall is a disjoint recursive prefix; otherwise the Arrow prefix is parsed once and following ! is attached by shape. Handwritten capped-view control remains opaque.

depth.detail: parse_type_head spends; nested forall calls parse_type_head again, arrows spend at parse_arrow_nested, and capped scanning itself spends nothing.

productions.name: EffLabel
productions.decision: ident is bare; uid/qual consume the name once and '(' selects optional CtorArgs.

depth.detail: Constructor arguments spend through parse_type_arg; a bare label is leaf.

productions.name: Param
productions.decision: Optional borrow is selected by its reserved token; Pattern is then parsed once, ':' selects Ann, and ':=' selects the optional default.

depth.detail: Pattern, optional Type, and optional Expr spend at their own entries.

productions.name: Params
productions.decision: The enclosing '(' has already selected a Comma<Param> list; positional normalization is a pure value action.

depth.detail: Parameter siblings reuse depth; each Pattern/Type/Expr child spends independently.

productions.name: Ann
productions.decision: ':' selects the annotation and commits to Type.

depth.detail: Type spends at parse_type.

productions.name: Type
productions.decision: forall is selected by its reserved head; otherwise parse Arrow once and inspect ! then optional @. The effect attachment/refusal owns the selected suffix.

depth.detail: parse_type is a frozen direct descend entry; forall calls parse_type, arrow codomains spend at parse_arrow_nested, and suffix loops do not spend.

productions.name: TypeSig
productions.decision: The public entry delegates to Type and requires caller-level complete consumption; there is no alternative.

depth.detail: The handwritten direct entry is parse_type, so TypeSig begins with the same frozen spend.

productions.name: Arrow
productions.decision: The two-token prefix '()' commits to the empty-domain form and then requires '->'; otherwise parse UType once and inspect '->' versus follow.

depth.detail: Each accepted arrow codomain enters parse_arrow_nested, which performs one frozen descend before recurring.

productions.name: ArrowEff
productions.decision: After mandatory !, '{' selects a row and every registered follow selects the bare-empty shorthand.

depth.detail: Effect-label TypeArgs spend at parse_type_arg; label siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: UType
productions.decision: Parse AType once; '@' selects a complete usage row and follow selects the bare atom. Validation happens after the row is consumed.

depth.detail: Nested AType children spend at their own Type entries; usage fact loops do not spend.

productions.name: CoeffRowParts
productions.decision: '{' selects the comma/tail row; ident selects the one-fact shorthand.

depth.detail: Fact and optional tail tokens are a nonrecursive sibling list.

productions.name: AType
productions.decision: Primitive/name/list/# heads are disjoint; ident/uid/qual consume once then inspect '('; '(' consumes a Type then inspects ')' versus comma; '#' inspects '(' versus '{'.

depth.detail: Delimited nested Type calls spend at parse_type; CtorArgs spend per parse_type_arg; tuple/list siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: Expr
productions.decision: Reserved top-form heads select their forms; ident followed by reserved fn/type selects reflect; otherwise parse the shared Call/Default prefix once and inspect assignment operators versus infix continuation.

depth.detail: parse_expr performs one frozen descend and its ordinary path enters parse_bp for a second spend; nested expression forms call parse_expr and spend again.

productions.name: CompoundOp
productions.decision: +=, -=, *=, and %= are disjoint fixed tokens.

depth.detail: One operator token is consumed.

productions.name: Default
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (1,1) makes ?? right-associative; absence or lower binding leaves the token unconsumed.

depth.detail: Each accepted ?? RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends; the loop itself does not spend.

productions.name: Qual
productions.decision: Reserved let and if heads are disjoint; their Pipe children are committed after the head.

depth.detail: Pipe is handled inside the already-spending Pratt path; nested top expressions spend only when explicitly entered.

productions.name: IfElse
productions.decision: Optional v; is inspected together with the next token; else versus elif is a bounded two-token selector.

depth.detail: Condition/branches call expression entries; elif recursion follows those spending children.

productions.name: OpenIfTail
productions.decision: Look through optional v;: elif selects an elif tail, v; followed by any Stmts head selects Rest, and a registered block follow selects End.

depth.detail: Tail recursion and statement siblings do not spend; nested conditions/branches/Stmts spend at expression entries.

depth.detail: parse_let_pattern is a frozen direct descend entry; nested components call parse_pattern and spend.

productions.name: MatchArms
productions.decision: '{' versus v{ selects real or layout arm delimiters; each commits to its matching closer.

depth.detail: Arm patterns and bodies spend at their entries; arm siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: HandleArms
productions.decision: '{' versus v{ selects comma or layout handler-arm mechanics and the matching closer.

depth.detail: Handler-arm bodies spend at expression entry; arm siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: CatchArms
productions.decision: '{' versus v{ selects comma or layout catch-arm mechanics and the matching closer.

depth.detail: Catch-arm bodies spend at expression entry; arm siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: CArms
productions.decision: CatchArm FIRST versus close selects entries; ArmSep versus close selects continuation.

depth.detail: Catch-arm siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: CatchArm
productions.decision: uid plus optional '(' binders is a fixed prefix committed by => to ExprOrBlock.

depth.detail: The body expression/block spends at its entry; binder siblings do not.

productions.name: HArms
productions.decision: HandlerArm FIRST versus close selects entries; ArmSep versus close selects continuation.

productions.name: HandlerArm
productions.decision: return and val are reserved selectors; ident '(' selects an operation, while ident ident selects a grade prefix. ResumeTail/follow selection is bounded after the binder list.

depth.detail: Arm bodies spend at expression entry; binder lists and grade selection do not spend.

productions.name: ResumeTail
productions.decision: Two ident tokens select the contextual resume tail; => follow selects the retired empty form. Payload validation is escaped.

depth.detail: At most two contextual tokens are consumed.

productions.name: Pipe
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (2,3) folds |> left; a nonmatching/lower-binding token ends the loop.

depth.detail: Each accepted RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends; the loop is nonspending.

productions.name: Compose
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (4,5) selects >> or << and folds left.

depth.detail: Each accepted composition RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends.

productions.name: ArmSep
productions.decision: comma and v; are disjoint fixed/layout separators.

depth.detail: One separator is consumed.

productions.name: Arms
productions.decision: Arm FIRST versus close selects entry; ArmSep versus close selects continuation.

depth.detail: Arm siblings reuse depth; pattern/body children spend.

productions.name: Arm
productions.decision: Parse Pattern once; 'if' selects a guard then =>, while immediate => selects the unguarded arm.

depth.detail: Pattern, optional guard Expr, and body ExprOrBlock spend at their entries.

productions.name: Pattern
productions.decision: Parse one PatAlt; '|' selects a nonempty sibling tail and every registered follow ends the alternation.

depth.detail: parse_pattern is a frozen direct descend entry; alternation siblings reuse its remaining budget.

productions.name: PatAlt
productions.decision: uid consumes once then '{' selects record, '(' selects args, and follow selects nullary ctor; qual has only ctor tail; other atom heads are disjoint.

depth.detail: Nested constructor args/record fields call parse_pattern and spend; the selector itself does not.

productions.name: RecordPatFields
productions.decision: '..' selects spread; ident starts a factored field list where comma followed by '..' selects the spread terminator and other field FIRST continues.

depth.detail: Field siblings reuse depth; explicit field Pattern children spend.

productions.name: RecordPatField
productions.decision: Consume ident once; '=' selects an explicit Pattern and comma/}/follow selects shorthand.

depth.detail: Explicit Pattern spends at parse_pattern; shorthand is leaf.

productions.name: PatAtom
productions.decision: Token kind selects literals/names; '-' plus one-token numeric lookahead selects signed literal; '[' inspects immediate ] versus list; '(' commits to Pattern comma tuple.

depth.detail: Nested list/tuple Pattern children spend; literal alternatives are leaf and sibling lists reuse depth.

productions.name: PatArgs
productions.decision: ( selects Comma<Pattern> and commits through ).

depth.detail: Each nested Pattern spends; argument siblings reuse depth.

productions.name: Or
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (6,7) selects || and folds left.

depth.detail: Each accepted RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends.

productions.name: And
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (8,9) selects && and folds left.

depth.detail: Each accepted RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends.

productions.name: Cmp
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (10,11) accepts one comparison, marks the comparison level blocked, and leaves a second comparison unconsumed.

depth.detail: An accepted comparison RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends; blocked_compare prevents a same-level second reduction.

productions.name: CmpOp
productions.decision: The six fixed comparison tokens are disjoint direct matches.

depth.detail: One operator token is consumed.

productions.name: DotCmpOp
productions.decision: The six retired fixed dot-comparison tokens are disjoint direct matches feeding the named Pratt fault.

depth.detail: One retired operator token is consumed before the fault.

productions.name: DotAddOp
productions.decision: +. and -. are disjoint direct matches feeding the named Pratt fault.

depth.detail: One retired operator token is consumed before the fault.

productions.name: DotMulOp
productions.decision: *. and /. are disjoint direct matches feeding the named Pratt fault.

depth.detail: One retired operator token is consumed before the fault.

productions.name: Add
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (12,13) selects + or - and folds left; retired dot forms fault at the same precedence.

depth.detail: Each accepted RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends; the loop does not.

productions.name: Mul
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (14,15) selects *, /, or % and folds left; retired dot forms fault at the same precedence.

depth.detail: Each accepted RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends.

productions.name: Neg
productions.decision: At operand position '-' selects prefix parsing with min_bp 16; all other atom heads select the postfix operand path.

depth.detail: Prefix '-' recursively enters parse_bp and performs a frozen spend.

productions.name: Pow
productions.decision: Specialized binding pair (17,16) makes ^ right-associative and admits prefix minus on its RHS.

depth.detail: Each accepted exponent RHS re-enters parse_bp and spends.

productions.name: Call
productions.decision: The specialized postfix spine's wide receiver state admits '.', '.#', '.[', '?.', or '?'; a matched opener commits, and a field result does not silently regain tight-call eligibility.

depth.detail: Postfix iterations do not spend; nested path/index expressions spend at parse_expr.

productions.name: CallTight
productions.decision: The tight receiver state admits '(' calls and '[' indices; factored '. ident (' is the explicit UFCS transition from a wide Call. The emitted direct match must carry this state to preserve Rust's no-direct-call-after-field restriction.

depth.detail: Postfix iterations are nonspending; argument/index/trailing-lambda bodies spend at their own entries.

productions.name: TrailerParams
productions.decision: '(' selects a nonempty Param list; BlockExpr FIRST/follow selects the empty form.

depth.detail: Parameter siblings reuse depth; their Pattern/Type/default children spend.

productions.name: Atom
productions.decision: Fixed/token-kind heads select ordinary atoms; '(' factors unit/group/annotation/tuple by next continuation, '#' factors tuple/record, '[' factors empty/list/range/comprehension after a shared prefix, and uid '{' factors record forms.

depth.detail: Nested Expr/Type/Path children spend at their entries; comma siblings reuse depth and atom selection itself does not spend.

productions.name: PathIndex
productions.decision: '[' selects exactly one Expr and commits through ']'.

depth.detail: The index Expr spends at parse_expr.

productions.name: PathSeg
productions.decision: ident, each, '? uid/qual', '(', and '[' are disjoint heads; '(' selects filtered nested steps and '[' selects one-or-more leading indices.
